title: Bug: Case test_ecn_config_updates[None-replace-green_max_threshold] failure after PR https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/23319 merged
author: echuawu
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

Case generic_config_updater.test_ecn_config_update#test_ecn_config_updates[None-replace-green_max_threshold] start to fail after https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/23319 merged

### Steps to Reproduce

Run the test on mellanox sn5640

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Case failed due to green_max_threshold check failure.
During configuration generation, it skipped configuration generated for Q4 and Q5:

```
INFO     tests.generic_config_updater.test_ecn_config_update:test_ecn_config_update.py:223 Skipping WRED profile AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q4: all deltas are 0, no real value change possible.
INFO     tests.generic_config_updater.test_ecn_config_update:test_ecn_config_update.py:223 Skipping WRED profile AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q5: all deltas are 0, no real value change possible.
```


```
DEBUG    tests.common.gu_utils:gu_utils.py:125 Patch Content: [
    {
        "op": "replace",
        "path": "/WRED_PROFILE/AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q3/green_max_threshold",
        "value": "282623"
    },
    {
        "op": "replace",
        "path": "/WRED_PROFILE/AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q3/green_max_threshold",
        "value": "282623"
    },
    {
        "op": "replace",
        "path": "/WRED_PROFILE/AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q2/green_max_threshold",
        "value": "282623"
    },
    {
        "op": "replace",
        "path": "/WRED_PROFILE/AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q2/green_max_threshold",
        "value": "282623"
    },
    {
        "op": "replace",
        "path": "/WRED_PROFILE/AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q1/green_max_threshold",
        "value": "282623"
    },
    {
        "op": "replace",
        "path": "/WRED_PROFILE/AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q1/green_max_threshold",
        "value": "282623"
    }
]
```

During check stage, it did not skip the check for Q4 and Q5, so the ASIC_DB checking was failing.

### Relevant log output

```shell
Failed: ASIC DB does not properly reflect newly configured field(s): ['green_max_threshold'] expected value(s): {'AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q3': {'green_max_threshold': 282623}, 'AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q3': {'green_max_threshold': 282623}, 'AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q2': {'green_max_threshold': 282623}, 'AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q2': {'green_max_threshold': 282623}, 'AZURE_LOSSY_DOWNLINK_Q1': {'green_max_threshold': 282623}, 'AZURE_LOSSY_UPLINK_Q1': {'green_max_threshold': 282623}}
```

### Output of `show version`

```shell
202511
```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Since https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/23319 was merged into 202511 we have been seeing failures in some variants of test_ecn_config_updates. This is because some of the wred profiles are being filtered out based on a "delta" value, but later it verifies these values against the unfiltered raw data from ASIC_DB, causing the check to fail in error.

#### How did you do it?
The fix for this is to also filter the set of wred objects from ASIC_DB by the same criteria as the CONFIG_DB wred profiles during the verification step.

#### How did you verify/test it?
Verified the affected testcases are now passing with the change in our automated test runs.
